test_title: PYST 19: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

Running into Sonya's room and not finding her there, / Natasha ran to the nursery,/ but Sonya was not there either.

options.text: Running into Sonya's room and not finding her there,
but Sonya was not there either.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the missing conjunction **"while"** at the beginning of part 2 to correctly depict the sequence of events.
 
• The sentence should read "Running into Sonya's room and not finding her there, **while** Natasha ran to the nursery, but Sonya was not there either." to maintain proper grammatical structure.
 
• Therefore, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Running into Sonya's room and not finding her there, **while** Natasha ran to the nursery, but Sonya was not there either.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "Running into Sonya's room and not finding her there, "** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "but Sonya was not there either."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error **– This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
